question: Aarav owns a watch worth Rs. 10,000. He sells it to Bhavin at a profit of 15%. After some days, Bhavin sells it back to Aarav at 15% loss. Find the percentage profit or loss faced by Aarav.
solution:
**Given:**

Initial value of the watch = Rs. 10,000

Profit percentage when Aarav sells to Bhavin = 15%

Loss percentage when Bhavin sells back to Aarav = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit Percentage/100)

New Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) × (1 - Loss Percentage/100)

Percentage Profit or Loss = [(Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value] × 100
